interests: Sci-fi thrillers exploring the psychological horror of forced immortality and fragmented memory, where characters struggle to distinguish past traumas from present reality in a world that treats rebirth as a curse rather than a gift.

Fast-paced YA action narratives blending coming-of-age growth with supernatural mystery, featuring unreliable narrators and high-stakes suspense that challenges the protagonist's perception of truth across time and space.

Dark fantasy stories combining nonstop combat sequences with deep introspection on identity, set in environments where magic and horror intertwine to create unexpected plot twists that defy standard genre formulas.
